rows.notes: Open seat. Al Green not running for re-election. Leticia Gutierrez (D) vs Roy Morales (R) in general. Cook/IE: Solid R.

Rep. Tony Gonzales (R) resigned from Congress effective April 14, 2026, amid sexual misconduct allegations. TX-23 is the largest district in Texas, spanning from west San Antonio to El Paso. Gov. Greg Abbott has not yet called a special election. If called, Texas law requires at least 36 days' notice. The next uniform election date is November 3, 2026.
Greg Casar (D) is the incumbent, elected in 2024 when TX-37 was redrawn. Lloyd Doggett moved to TX-33.
